answers.title: Overshot Water Wheel
answers.fullText: This image shows two types of overshot water wheels. On the left, we can see the standard design, and on the right is the pitchback version. Water flows from the flume at the top and hits the wheel buckets. This makes the wheel turn. The water then falls into the tail race at the bottom. The main difference between the two designs is the direction of water flow and how it hits the wheel. Both designs use gravity and water power to create rotation.

answers.title: Projected Population, Australia
answers.fullText: This graph shows the projected population of Australia from 2001 to 2101. There are three different series. Series A shows the highest growth, reaching about 60 million by 2101. Series B is in the middle, growing to around 45 million. Series C shows the lowest growth, staying at about 33 million. All three series start at roughly the same point in 2001, around 20 million people. Overall, the graph shows that Australia's population will continue to grow, but the rate depends on different factors.

answers.title: Population Density, Australia (June 2010)
answers.fullText: This map shows the population density of Australia in June 2010. The colors represent how many people live in each area per square kilometer. We can see that most people live along the coast, especially in the eastern and southeastern areas, which are shown in dark orange and red. These areas have 100 or more people per square kilometer. The center of Australia is very light yellow, which means less than 0.1 people per square kilometer. The map clearly shows that Australia's population is mainly concentrated in coastal cities, while the inland areas are very sparsely populated.

answers.title: Trading Goods, Ancient Egypt
answers.fullText: This diagram shows the trading goods of ancient Egypt. On the left side, we can see the imports. Egypt brought in cedar oil and timber from Lebanon, copper and gold from Nubia, and exotic animals from tropical Africa. They also imported horses, fruit, and honey from Mediterranean countries. On the right side, we have the exports. Ancient Egypt sold linen, tools, beads, beer, weapons, and oil to other regions. This shows that ancient Egypt had a strong trading network with many different countries and regions around the Mediterranean and Africa.

The smallest group is 85 and above, with only 0.4% for females and 0.8% for males. Overall, the chart shows that most graduates are in the younger age groups, and there are slightly more male graduates than female graduates in almost every age category.

answers.title: The Eatwell Plate (Nutrition Guide)
answers.fullText: This diagram shows the eatwell plate, which is a guide for healthy eating. The plate is divided into five food groups. The biggest section in green is for fruit and vegetables, which should make up the largest part of our diet. The yellow section shows bread, rice, potatoes, and pasta - these starchy foods are the second largest group. The smaller sections include milk and dairy foods in blue, and meat, fish, eggs, and beans in pink. The smallest purple section at the bottom represents foods high in fat and sugar, which we should eat less often. This plate helps us understand how to balance our meals for better health.

answers.title: Bone Structure Comparison (Evolution)
answers.fullText: This diagram compares the bone structure of four different limbs. At the top, we can see a human arm with the humerus, radius, and ulna bones, plus the hand and wrist bones. Below that is a seal limb, which has the same basic bones but shaped differently for swimming. The third example is a bird wing, where the same bones are present but much lighter and adapted for flying. At the bottom is a bat wing, which also has similar bones but with extended fingers to support the wing. This shows how different animals have the same basic bone structure, but each is adapted for different purposes like swimming, flying, or grasping.

answers.title: Keyboard Ergonomics (Right and Wrong Positions)
answers.fullText: This diagram shows the right and wrong ways to use a keyboard. At the top left, we can see the correct position. Your wrists should be straight and level with the keyboard. On the top right, there are two wrong positions where the wrists are bent upward or to the sides. At the bottom left, the side view shows the right position again, with a straight wrist and forearm in line with the keyboard. The bottom right shows the wrong position from the side, where the wrist is bent either up or down. This guide helps us avoid injury and type more comfortably by keeping our wrists straight and relaxed.

answers.title: Adding an Article to Wikipedia (Flowchart)
answers.fullText: This flowchart shows the process of adding an article to Wikipedia. First, you search Wikipedia to see if the topic already exists. If you find it, you should think of another term to search for. If you don't find it, you check if there is a related term. If there is no related term, you can create a new article. If there is a related term, you create a redirect instead. The flowchart uses green for the starting point, blue boxes for questions, and pink circles for the different actions you can take. This makes it easy to follow the decision-making process step by step.

answers.title: Fungus Gnat Lifecycle
answers.fullText: This diagram shows the lifecycle of a fungus gnat. The cycle starts at the top with the adult stage, which lasts 3 to 6 days. The adult lays eggs, shown on the right side. The eggs take 7 to 10 days to develop. After that, the eggs hatch into larvae at the bottom, which takes 4 to 6 days. Next, the larva becomes a pupa on the left side, and this stage lasts 12 to 14 days. Finally, the pupa turns into an adult, and the cycle starts again. The whole lifecycle takes about 26 to 36 days in total.

answers.title: Beijing, China Temperature Chart
answers.fullText: This chart shows the daily high and low temperatures in Beijing, China, throughout the year. The red line shows the daily high temperatures, and the blue line shows the daily low temperatures. The coldest months are January and February, where the low temperature drops to about minus 10 degrees. The temperature starts to rise in spring, reaching its peak in July and August at around 30 degrees for the high. After August, the temperature gradually falls again. The background colors change from blue in winter to green in spring, yellow in summer, and orange in autumn, which makes it easy to see the seasonal changes.

answers.title: Fish Behavior and Moon Phases
answers.fullText: This diagram shows how fish behavior changes during different moon phases. At the top, we can see four different moon phases from left to right. The blue area below represents the water from surface to bottom. In the first panel with a crescent moon, most fish stay near the bottom. In the second panel with a larger moon, the fish start to spread out in the middle area. In the third panel with a full moon, the fish are scattered at all levels - some at the surface, some in the middle, and some at the bottom. In the last panel, most fish move toward the surface. This shows that the moon phase affects where fish swim in the water.

answers.title: Climate Zones for Temperature and Humidity, Australia
answers.fullText: This map shows the climate zones for temperature and humidity across Australia. The legend on the left shows six different climate types. The northern part of Australia is shown in red, which means hot and humid. The central area is mostly yellow, showing hot dry summers and cold winters. The orange areas near the coast show hot dry summers with warm winters. Along the southern coast, we can see green areas which are temperate zones. Tasmania at the bottom is shown in blue, meaning it has a cool temperate climate. This map clearly shows that Australia has very different climate zones, with tropical conditions in the north and cooler weather in the south.

answers.title: Pet Expenditure in US
answers.fullText: This pie chart shows how people in the US spend money on their pets. The largest category is vet care and wellbeing in orange, which takes up 47 percent of all pet spending. The second largest is food and litter in blue at 41 percent. Services like grooming and boarding make up 10 percent shown in gray. The smallest category is pet purchase in yellow, which is only 2 percent. This shows that most pet owners spend their money on keeping their pets healthy and well-fed, rather than buying new pets.

answers.title: Adults vs. Teens: Number of Texts on a Typical Day
answers.fullText: This bar chart compares how many texts adults and teens send on a typical day. The dark blue bars show adults, and the light blue bars show teens. Most adults, 51 percent, send 1 to 10 texts per day. In contrast, only 22 percent of teens send this amount. For people who text more, 29 percent of teens send more than 101 texts daily, while only 8 percent of adults send this many. Very few people send no texts at all - just 9 percent of adults and 2 percent of teens. Overall, this chart shows that teens send much more text messages than adults do each day.

answers.title: What is E-Waste?
answers.fullText: This chart shows what types of items make up e-waste. The chart is divided into two main groups. The top half shows electronic waste in yellow and green colors, which makes up 50 percent. This includes monitors at 10 percent, televisions at 10 percent, computers and printers at 15 percent, and DVD players and radios at 15 percent. The bottom half shows electric waste in blue, which also makes up 50 percent. This includes refrigerators at 20 percent, and washing machines, dryers, and other appliances at 30 percent. Overall, we can see that electric appliances make up the largest part of e-waste.

answers.title: Internet Users Who Accessed via Mobile Phone, GB 2011
answers.fullText: This bar chart shows the percentage of internet users who accessed the internet via mobile phone in Great Britain in 2011, broken down by age groups. The youngest group, aged 16 to 24, has the highest usage at about 71 percent. The next group, aged 25 to 34, shows around 65 percent. Usage drops to about 49 percent for ages 35 to 44, then continues to fall to 33 percent for ages 45 to 54. The older age groups show much lower usage, with only 21 percent for ages 55 to 64, and just 8 percent for people aged 65 and above. Overall, this chart clearly shows that younger people use mobile internet much more than older people.

answers.title: Food Pyramid with Daily Serving Recommendations
answers.fullText: This food pyramid shows the recommended daily servings for different food groups. At the bottom, we should drink 8 servings of water each day. The next level shows rice, pasta, bread, and cereal, with 6 servings recommended. Moving up, the pyramid shows vegetables with 3 servings and fruits with 2 servings. The next level includes the milk group with 3 servings and the meat, fish, and bean group with 2 servings. At the top, fats, oils and sweets should be used sparingly. The pyramid also suggests taking calcium, vitamin D, and vitamin B-12 supplements. This guide helps us understand how to balance our daily food intake.

answers.title: The Iron Age Hut
answers.fullText: This diagram shows the structure of an Iron Age hut. The hut has a simple triangular shape with a reed thatch roof at the top. The two sides of the roof are labeled as rafter on the left and reed thatch on the right. At ground level, there are turf walls on both sides for support. Inside the hut, we can see seats built into the walls and ashes in the center, which was probably where they made fires for cooking and heating. The structure sits at ground level with a raised floor inside. This shows how people in the Iron Age built simple but effective shelters using natural materials like reeds, turf, and wood.

answers.title: Two Examples of "Input-Process-Output"
answers.fullText: This diagram shows two examples of the input-process-output model. At the top, we can see the basic concept with three boxes: input, process, and output. The first example shows a factory process. Materials go in as the input, they are processed in a factory, and the output is a finished product. The second example shows a computer process. Data goes in as the input, it is processed by a computer system, and the output is useful information. Both examples follow the same pattern, showing how raw inputs are changed through a process to create something valuable as the output.

We can also see some orange areas in the east. The northern zone is mostly light beige, which means it produces very little honey, between 0 to 1 percent. Overall, this map shows that central and southern Mexico are the main honey-producing regions, while the north has very low production.

answers.title: Distribution of Tropical Rain Forests

First, there is a large area in South America. Second, we see forests in central Africa. And third, there are forests in Southeast Asia and nearby islands. All these forests are located near the equator in hot and humid tropical zones. The map also shows all the major continents and oceans. Overall, this shows that tropical rain forests only grow in specific areas close to the equator, where the climate is warm and wet all year round.

Red and dark red colors show the hottest areas, which are around the equator, with temperatures reaching up to 30 degrees Celsius. The areas in between show yellow, orange, and light blue, which means moderate temperatures. We can clearly see that the closer to the equator, the hotter it gets, and the closer to the poles, the colder it gets.

answers.title: Journeys by Men and Women in the UK 2006
answers.fullText: This bar chart compares the journeys made by men and women in the United Kingdom in 2006 according to their purpose. The red bars show women and the blue bars show men. Shopping is the biggest reason for women, at about 25 percent, while men only shop around 18 percent of the time. For commuting and business, the pattern is opposite - men make up about 25 percent while women are around 18 percent. Both men and women visit friends at similar levels, around 12 percent each. The school run is higher for women than men. Walking, holiday trips, and sports are the smallest categories for both groups. Overall, this shows that women travel more for shopping and family activities, while men travel more for work.

answers.title: Acid Rain Formation
answers.fullText: This diagram shows how acid rain is formed. On the left, we can see the sun, which drives photochemical reactions. In the center, there is a large cloud labeled oxidation. Below the cloud, we see acid rain falling to the ground. On the right side, there is text showing that acid plus rain equals acidrain. At the bottom, there are buildings on the left, some trees, and a lake in the middle. The diagram shows that pollution from buildings and other sources goes up into the clouds, where oxidation happens, and this creates acid rain that falls back down to earth.

answers.title: Years to Double Population
answers.fullText: This line graph shows the years it takes for the world population to double. The vertical line shows years to double, and the horizontal line shows the ending year. The line starts very high on the left and drops down to the right. In the early 1700s, it took over 500 years for the population to double. But over time, this number keeps getting smaller. By 1800, it took about 300 years. Then in 1927, it only took 123 years. The most recent point shows it took less than 50 years in 1974. Overall, this graph shows that the population is doubling much faster now than it did in the past.

Overall, this graph shows that drug arrests went up and down quite a lot over this 15-year period.

Overall, this chart shows that China's electricity generation doubled over this period, with most growth coming from conventional thermal power.

answers.title: Annual per capita Meat Consumption (kg)
answers.fullText: This line graph shows annual per capita meat consumption in kilograms from 1961 to 2009. The vertical line shows kilograms, and the horizontal line shows the years. There are six lines shown in the legend for different countries. The blue line for USA stays the highest throughout the period, starting at about 90 kg and ending at around 120 kg. The other three countries - Liberia, India, and Ethiopia - all stay very low throughout the period at around 10 to 20 kg. Overall, this shows that USA has the highest meat consumption, while China shows the fastest growth over this period.

answers.title: Drinking Habits by Age in US
answers.fullText: This stacked bar chart shows drinking habits by age in the US. The vertical line shows percentage, and the horizontal line shows age groups from 16-24 to 65-74. There are four categories shown in the legend. Blue represents never drinker, orange represents ex-drinker, red represents light drinker, and green represents heavy drinker. For all age groups, never drinkers make up the largest portion, staying around 45 to 60 percent. Light drinkers are the second largest group at about 25 to 40 percent. Ex-drinkers make up a small portion, increasing slightly from about 10 percent in younger groups to about 35 percent in the 65-74 group. Heavy drinkers are the smallest category, staying fairly constant at around 5 to 10 percent across all ages. Overall, this chart shows that most people in the US are either never drinkers or light drinkers.

answers.title: Adults Healthy BMI Chart
answers.fullText: This chart shows the adults healthy BMI chart. The vertical line shows weight in kilos from 50 to 110, and the horizontal line shows height in meters from 1.36 to 2.00. The chart is divided into different colored zones representing BMI categories. The red zone in the top left corner represents extremely obese. Below that, the yellow zone represents obese. The pink and purple zone in the middle represents overweight. The light purple and blue zone represents healthy weight. The green zone in the bottom right corner represents underweight. The chart helps people find their BMI category by looking at where their height and weight meet on the chart. Overall, this is a useful tool for checking if your weight is healthy for your height.
